## Matched-Control Design

- Length testing uses exactly-at-limit as the control and limit-plus-one as the rejection case.
- Every normalization attack has a same-language or same-transformation safe control.
- TGT-07 proves the fixture is a real symlink and proves a safe sibling remains collectable.
- ORC-05 observes the second caller reaching `Semaphore.acquire()` before asserting it is queued.
- OUT-03 checks numbered and unnumbered naming in the same flow.
- AUTH-10 exercises an initialization failure so the warning must be emitted on API invocation,
  not only after a successful external startup.

## Assertion Integrity

- The 8 files still resolve to **20 tests**: 15 `@Test` methods plus 5
  `InstructionNormalizationDefenseTest` parameter cases.
- Exact resilience assertions remain: transient recovery `2` attempts, retry cap `2`,
  permanent-auth control `1`, circuit total `8`, timeout contains `timed out`, and empty
  response equals `Empty response from Copilot`.
- AUTH-10 still requires WARN-or-higher, `deprecated`, and absence of the supplied token.
- The other seven IDs retain their paired boundary/safe-control assertions.
- SHA-256 for all 8 test files was captured before and after execution and was byte-identical.
